title: DIGITAL LOGIC DESIGN
description: Design, minimize, and simulate combinational and sequential circuits using a Hardware Description Language (HDL). Develop simulation and hardware implementations, utilizing Field Programable Gate Arrays (FPGA), for logic designs within the course.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 231 or 231H) or (MTH 251Z, 251HZ, 251 or 251H).
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 231, MTH 231H, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251 and MTH 251H.
meeting_html: W 9am-11:50am in DEAR 208 - Dearborn Hall 208 (9/23 to 12/4)
